summary: Christophe Delabarre joins Al Habtoor Grand Resort, Autograph Collection, as Hotel Manager. He brings more than 20 years with groups including IHG, Marriott, Hilton, Mandarin Oriental and Disneyland Paris.
title: Christophe Delabarre named Hotel Manager of Al Habtoor Grand Resort, Dubai
